question: What contemplative and self-originating divine status is affirmed here?
premises: The being is the god of gods.
The being is greatly to be contemplated.
The being is the soul of the gods and self-born.
inference: The divine is the self-born, contemplable god of gods and soul of deities.
plain_english: He is the god of gods, greatly to be contemplated, the soul of the gods, and self-born.
